title: FoundryCandidateSkill to SkillStudioDraft
root_cause: Foundry materializes candidate files without a typed, signed, lineage-preserving Studio intake envelope.
source_requirement: Bridge Foundry candidates into Skill Studio drafts while preserving hashes, citations, mechanisms, formulas, uncertainty, semantics, effects, and tests.
implementation_steps: Define candidate and draft envelope schemas.
Bind source lineage and candidate hash.
Translate supported fields without losing unknowns/contradictions.
Require explicit Studio accept or reject; prohibit direct canonical promotion.
affected_tests: Knowledge Foundry and Skill Studio tests.
evidence_required: Accept/reject lineage vectors and no-direct-promotion proof.
rollback: Disable bridge intake and preserve Foundry candidate bundle unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Every draft binds the exact candidate and lineage.
Only Skill Studio can advance the draft toward canonical promotion.
